claims.claim: The new regression tests reproduce the Greptile findings: run against the pre-fix ci_runners source they fail (26 failed, 9 errors).
Ruff format check passes for omega_prime/.
polyglot-check reports 0 errors on all changed files.
The ci_runners package suite passes (277 passed, 1 skipped).
Scaler-core branch coverage is 99%, above the 90% gate (--fail-under=90).
pip check, evals and prompt assembly check pass.
Env inventory policy and generated configuration doc are current after re-pinning the two changed settings helpers.
Docs, public-repo and env-inventory tests pass with the final docs.
Full omega_prime/tests suite fails only on pre-existing environmental tests (17 failed; prime-kernel/oneclick).
Every full-suite failure on this change also fails on the base commit bd8bb17 (no new failures).

unverified: No live GitHub webhook, JIT runner registration or App installation-token exchange; GitHub is faked in tests.
No Railway desktop wake or real agent HTTP round trip over the network; the desktop client is driven by scripted transports.
Pulsar delayed delivery of RetryDeadline is tested with a fake producer/consumer, not a live broker.
Controller restart demand replay tested with an on-disk JSON file in tmp, not under systemd on the VPS.
0600 secret-file enforcement not exercised on the VPS filesystem; the operator docs were updated but no host was changed (held).

17 full-suite failures (test_prime_kernel_* and test_grokbot_oneclick) are environmental on this box (uninitialised prime-agent submodule); they were compared against the base commit rather than fixed.
Greptile re-review and GitHub Actions results are recorded after push, not in this receipt.
contract_changes: SecretFile/SecretValue now require an audience and read through omega_prime.credentials.CredentialBroker; secret files must be mode 0600 (was tolerated at 0640).
New runner event kinds: finished, launch_backoff, launch_retry, launch_circuit_open, launch_circuit_closed.
rollback_plan: Revert the PR #87 round-1 commit; no deploy or host change was made.
